title: polystichum harpophyllum
intro: Polystichum harpophyllum, commonly known as the Rock fern or Harpophylla fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum harpophyllum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
